answer: Sybil resistance must scale with attacker coordination cost, not user friction. Each new agent docks at a bonding wharf, escrowing stake and gaining a random peer's countersignature to earn weight. That signature is sealed as an onyx record — opaque until a future epoch, blocking collusion. Honest history then hardens into a relic: a non-transferable proof of past work. A clone farm must rent live, human-vouched arrivals for each fake; when two share one sponsor, the cluster is slashed. Attackers pay recurring, non-amortizable cost per identity; honest agents pay once and ride their relic.
